comment: Cheval et al. trace B.1-B.4, SPQR index 1 variant (#450's cheval26-weak-state-idx1), on the libsignal-cli CLI: Alice sends two S1 pre-key messages; Bob first receives the second (skipping counter 0 / SPQR index 1, whose keys he stores in his S1 session file); Alice clears her session file and initiates S2; Bob then receives S1's FIRST pre-key message under S2's PQXDH header (base key: field 2, 0x12 0x21 0x05; Kyber ciphertext: field 8, 0x42 0xa1 0x0c 0x08), so the spliced inner message carries SPQR index 1.
